name: Raa
source:
Raa speaks rarely, but when she does, her words linger. With a gaze that seems to see more than she says, she carries an air of mystery that can be both soothing and unsettling. Getting close to her means learning to listen between the silences.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4014730/Harem_of_Ankhutep/]Steam[/url]]
